nom: NuFACE Hydrating Aqua Gel Microcurrent Activator

avis.texte: I think it's pricey but it does work. Wish it was a squeeze bottle instead of a pump because it's difficult to get to the last little bit. Also, make the bottles shorter & fatter so it fits upright in drawers.
I have gone through like 15 of these and it's good. It makes my Nuface device work better than any activator.
This gel works great with my NuFace. I don't have any issues with it being too heavy or not absorbing into my skin after use. I know that it's necessary to use a gel and I like this.

I am going to buy a second bottle just to have another close by. I use to use another product that was discontinued and I was searching for a new facial massage gel. This product works well. I have a healthy glow to my skin! Happy customer here!

I have been using the Nuface for close to two years. I was a bit nervous to use the gel activator, as I have very sensitive skin. This gel doesn't irritate my skin at all, makes my skin smooth, and works well with the Nuface device. I've repurchased many times as I enjoy using it!
Skin broke out terribly in red bumps everywhere - couldn't use again
This is a great product. Frankly, I use it more often than I use any other. I always use the peptide serum underneath. A great combo.
Used this product twice on my face and my face has now broke out in red itchy bumps and it's extremely dry. Won't buy again

avis.titre: Might not be worth the cost
avis.texte: Works pretty well, way too expensive for the amount of product you have to use without getting zapped.
SCAM product ALERT!!! The NuFace products are NOT worth anything! Don't waste your money!

Truly do love my NuFace, this microcurrent activator gel has been great for daily use and has never caused any irritation for me. One thing to note- is that it can dry out pretty quick when applied to the skin. I would reccomend wetting the face before application, as using a serum or lotion may create a barrier. Overall, this activator has worked well for me.
Liked previous version better. New version is thinner & runnier

avis.titre: Ok but pricey for what it is
avis.texte: Ok but pricey. I have to wash it off quickly because it makes me break out
I prefer the easy to use pump bottle. I always get the large size so I never run out.
I'm on my 4th bottle and I've been using it for 6 months now. I don't have a skin reaction as compared to the old formula/packaging.

Spent a fortune on Nuface + Trinity (complete set) Which gave you a free small bottle of the primer and I purchased the small bottle of primer as well I had the Nuface mini a couple of years ago and the primer was a lot less expensive So far using it as well as the new Nuface + trinity, im not seeing a difference before using However, I did see some other conductive gels that has multiple peptides, hyaluronic acid, paraben free that are much less expensive that I will be trying. Overall product is so expensive, hoping to see some results.

This activator does what its supposed to but it I need more of it to do so now. I'm not sure if the texture is thinner or what. I compared ingredients of the old activator with this new "hydrating aqua gel..." and there is a slight difference. Also, this product doesn't warrant this type of packaging. This is not skincare and so much of the product doesn't get used. I'll have to take this into consideration for my next microcurrent activator purchase.
I received this item but it does not feel like a good conductor to use my nuface.
Aqua Gel Activator feels great on the skin and is very easy to dispense.
In our fifth week of using. We can actually tell a difference in our skin.!
I love my Nu-Face products. This accelerator is necessary for device to work properly! I tried other products less expensive and they don't work! I'll keep buying this!g

avis.titre: So much better than the cheap stuff!
avis.texte: I tried using the cheaper ultrasound gel, but it's so hard to wash off. I found myself not doing my microcurrent just to avoid the gel. When I splurged and bought the Nuface gel in the pump, I was able to easily integrate microcurrent routine into my daily routine. I love that I can leave this gel on and it's fine under my moisturizer/makeup. The pump works great for me!

Every blogger everywhere will tell you that you can use aloe vera gel or ultrasound gel etc. etc. for device conductivity. I have tried a number of different lower-cost gels and I am here to say that the Aqua Gel Activator wins hands-down. Don't get me wrong--you'll get your lift using a proper gel from the drugstore--but with the Aqua Gel Activator I get zero skin redness. I can do my treatment and my skin looks fresh and great. With the other gels I have tried, I actually end up with a ruddy color on my face and neck where I've done my glides. The redness lasts about half an hour. I don't know why this is, but I do know that I'll stick with NuFace's gel from now on, even if it is pricey.
Bought while on holiday AZ. New packaging of gel not good for carry on travel. Too big and bulky, Especially International. Also hard to express gel if have arthritic hands. Like the original tubes.

I bought a NuFace Mini+ starter kit about a month ago. It's a game changer and I LOVE it!!!! I used all of the aqua gel already, now I'm using the silk crème activator. Arguably, I might prefer the silk crème activator, BUT it's not as moist so you have to use what *seems* like more compared to the gel, plus it's more expensive. So, I re-upped on the gel activator! It's more affordable and stays "wetter" longer so I feel like I can get through as much of a treatment as I want, not just til the activator pre-maturely dries out and I get little zaps lol. I love a hyaluronic acid moment, and love that my face is firmed and sculpted from the device, and my skin is hydrated from the activator. The gel feels a little sticky after I complete my treatment, but it's fine, I just rinse it off well and pat my face mostly dry and voila! I love incorporating a NuFace treatment w/ the gel in the morning, it's really elevated my skincare/self care and my neck, jaw, and jowls look so much more sculpted.
The product works well as a conductor. However, it flakes after a while if left on the skin.

Long time user, love my device, do not like this pump, it doesn't work at times, don't know how much remains, has added skin care ingredients I didn't need since I wash it off when done-it's sticky, and it's too expensive. Please bring back the tube
Great product, which makes using the NuFace Mini painless and easy. My skin feels great afterward.
A little goes a long way. Add a little water over the gel; this keeps gel from drying.
Doesn't absorb like cream but does provide the barrier needed before using device.

My most recent purchase was the Silk Creme, not the Aqua Gel. I actually love the Silk Creme and will be using it from now on. The Aqua Gel is too thick and I don't like using it. Unfortunately, after using the Silk Creme twice, my device will now no longer hold a charge. Hopefully these two things aren't related!
Love the new product. But feel it takes too much to get the job done.
It does the job while using the different microcurrent devices but I don't see any benefit of hydration. Not even close to my moisturizer.
For me, I like this much better than the Silk Creme. It is easier for my skin care application, whereas the silk creme leaves my face feeling greasy.
Easy to apply. Leaves no residue. I bought the large size. It comes with a convenient pump.

avis.titre: AQUA GEL make with Glacial water
avis.texte: I use this NuFace AQUA Gel with all of my NuFace and Nu Skin micro-courant skin treatment devises. The price is good. You can leave the gel on after you do your facial devises and it's not greasy or sticky and just rub it into your skin and your ready to go .

First - I love, love Nu Face. This is not a review about the device, only the mini-sized gel. I ordered the mini for travel and it is not travel-friendly. The round container is bulky, and a terrible shape to try to fit into a quart-sized container. I used to get their other primer that was in travel-friendly packaging but can't seem to find it anymore. Not sure if it is being replaced with this - if so, PLEASE redesign the travel size to actually work for travel.
Very hydrating, newer better product, comfortable leaving in overnight
I like the way it smooths on. I have been using Aveda gel so I'll let you know if NuFace Activator works better. Time will tell!
I love that once I'm done using my NuFace Mini I can just rub this product in and my skin just sucks it up and looks so healthy and dewy afterwards.
Works well with the Nuface. I prefer the Aqua Gel over the Silk Crème.
I like it very much It relly helps the products to glide over. Your skin.
Excellent product, I use this activator with my nubody device on my arms. It works very well. I am seeing results. Very happy

avis.titre: great product to use with the nuface device
avis.texte: Makes it easy to use the nuface device - I like also it is non-sticky and has not any particular smell
I love how plump and hydrated my skin looks when using the aqua gel with my NUFACE Mini. Great results!

I've had my NuFace Mini for 4 years, barely used it because I found the primer gel terribly inconvenient, rendering it unpleasant to use. I've used Neutrogena's Hydro Boost gel and couldn't tolerate the fragrance. Thank goodness NuFace came up with a new formula! I'm happily using my device, finally, thanks to the new conductive gel. I have yet to determine if it is priced reasonably. I'll see how many doses I get out of it, then decide.
Love it! So hydrating & good! Use it on my neck w/ my Trinity. I love the silk creme for my face since I'm 59.

Nice because it isn't too thick and doesn't take too long to dry. I like this for my face as I have oily skin. But I use more than the other/original version because it absorbs quickly. I like to use other/original version for my neck. It doesn't absorb as quickly and I didn't have to use as much.
Good conducting gel but the container looks larger than the amount of product you actually get. If used as instructed you run out of the gel very quickly.
I am so excited about my new skin care routine. I especially love the aqua gel activator. It helps so much when I use the micro current tools.
I use this with Nu Face and it's wonderful for my skin and hydrates with no breakouts. Nu Face is a great product also. It works.
Love it and terrified I'll run out some day. I just also ordered the Silk Creme after watching the webinar. I learned so much and I'm vigilant about using my Trinity. Thank you! Kathy
Pump at the top of the 10 oz bottles makes it easy to dispense and apply. Gel is light and smooth yet sinks in to hydrate my skin.

I use this product with an older device and the new Nuface FIX line smoothing device for around lips and between eyes and I am really liking it. I also use the gel with a older microcurrent device call NuSkin.
This product is easy to apply, and the pump is very convenient
I used the product for over a year, but do not see much effects...

I love the texture & size but don't see intense results from this compared to my normal hyaluronic serums. 4/5 for me, creates great glide and protection from shock from the Nuface device but i don't notice drastic difference in my skin elasticity and texture since I've added this in. Going to rebuy for the Nuface but not sure if it's needed if you expect long term/immediate drastic effects.

The gel doesn't go very far, it's expensive and it irritates the skin around my eyes if it gets close. The product at this point in time isn't showing the results I hoped it would. I also hate the fact that you can only use the device on clean skin

I received my device for Christmas. This was included with my NuFACE Trinity and my skin does not like it. Each time I apply it, my skin gets red and irritated. This reaction gets worse with more I apply and I am frustrated. I want to love this device but since I can't use this activator, I am at a loss and would love to speak with customer service about an alternative product to use? I cannot find a way to get in touch with NuFACE customer support. Please, if someone from the company reads my review, I would appreciate a response or email offering any advice. Thanks!

I purchased a 10 oz bottle of this back in June/July when it launched & I will say that I still have a decent amount left in the bottle at least enough for another 3 maybe even 4 months. I do use my Nuface on a regular basis (at least 4-5x's per week) & this gel lasts longer then their original hydrating gel in my opinion, so it is worth the slightly higher price. I do leave the gel on after lifting if I am just applying sunscreen. I have to remove the gel if I plan on applying any extra serum, moisturizer, or makeup b/c, at least for me, it doesn't allow for good absorption and kinda gunks up on my face. Which that's okay with me removing it when necessary, but that is why I gave it 4 stars instead of 5. All in all a great product.
The texture is beautiful. I like this much better than the original.
When I am feeling a little more dehydrated and my skin feels tight I use the aqua gel with my nuface. It really hydrates my skin an helps with a good lift.
Great product I love that I can leave on. I like to use the new face before I go to bed and wake up with no puffiness.

My original intent was to order the cream,, but it was sold out so I gave this a try.. This product provides a great vehicle to help my nuface glide on the skin with elegant ingredients..however when finished, despite massaging into skin, it leaves a very tacky feel. If applying other creams/foundation, products roll off. Almost like a gommage.
This feels exactly the same as the old gel? I was hoping for something less goopy and more of a skincare product. Bummer

Tried Aqua Gel, was not sure I would get much moisture from this. But after using the Trinity device my skin was smoother and well moisturized. My skin felt good for hours afterwards, I have dry skin! Great product!

I am loving this Aqua Gel! I feel like my skin is completely moisturized after, and doesn't leave any sticky residue. The brush and new push application is really nice as well, definitely an upgrade from the old version. I would definitely recommend trying to anyone that wants extra moisture while getting your normal NuFACE benefits!
My skin looks plumped and younger. My neck is my main concern and with this product it looks younger.
Great addition to the NuFace line. Skin felt hydrated for hours!!

I got this as part of a promotion Nuface had on IG. I went ahead and ordered a new bottle of the aqua gel. (I also ordered the creme to try) First let me say make sure you get the brush! It's amazing, so soft, applies product smoothly and no more messy hands. I felt the old "primer gel" was a little on the sticky side and left a residue behind. This new aqua gel is so much better. I feel like I don't have to use as much product and I get better results. It feels like it hydrates more, isn't sticky and no residue. The push pump top allows you to control the amount of product you get without wasting any. I love this new line of products and can't wait to try the creme next.
Received this as a gift. The Aqua Gel feels very light compared to the regular gels sold. Seemed as if one needed less product, because it didn't dry as fast.
I used the Aqua gel and love it. It didn't feel sticky and it glides on my face easily without drying to quickly on each section of my face as I used my trinity device.

Just started this 7-5-21, It is amazing and the brush is so much easier applying the product. I can not get enough of NuFace and it's products. I am obsessed. Being able to do this from home at anytime is perfect.
Make my skin feel so smooth. I live in s very very dry climate and this will be my new go to
Received a sample and I love it. Easily wipes on with a brush in just the correct amount. Feels great on and mixes will with my tinted sunscreen if I leave it on.

I was so excited to be chosen to try this but had no idea how much I would actually love this new aqua activator!!! It's AMAZING. The texture is lighter than the original but the hydration is incredible. My skin literally glows after using it. I'm a fan and will definitely order more!

The Aqua Gel is so smooth and isn't sticky on my skin. It feels really good! My skin felt so plumped when I was finished using my Nuface device with the Aqua Gel! I absolutely love the way my skin felt.
I just received this in the mail and it works wonderfully! So smooth! great product

Both the new silk cream and the aqua hydrating gel are now my favorite products to use with my Trinity! Thank you for continuing to make such helpful products to keep us young and vibrant even in our 60's!

avis.titre: I love the Hydrating Aqua Gel
avis.texte: I notice a difference after the first time using. I highly recommend the Hydrating Aqua Gel
Product sent as a gift from NuFACE so I was surprised - and delighted. It works well and I expect to purchase the gel in the future. Thank you and I appreciate the introduction to this product.
Like always nuface products are the best. At 60 my face hasn't looked better. I do have some age spots and a few wrinkles but it bright its looks fresh and not fake. I'm aging gracefully. Thank you

I just received this two days ago and I'm LOVING it! I have every "hydrating" product you can imagine because I'm trying to keep my skin happy and hydrated but guys this one steals the show! Its the kind of gel that doesn't leave your skin feeling slimy but does what it's promising and leaves you feeling moisturized! I use it as one of the last steps in my morning routine and normally I use an all day face moisturizer after using my nuface but with this gel I don't feel like I need it anymore. Which is great because I hate blowing through products and this gel has saved me from having to restock on face lotion. This is definitely a product I'll be buying again…and again and again lol
I love this product! My skin looks and feels amazing after just the 1st use.
This gel is a huge improvement from the previous one. I can tell my skin is much more hydrated and moisturized after using! Great job!
